title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

suppliers.sup:70110: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200: cost basis and revised proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

We value continuity with your foundry and want a sustainable agreement. Could you provide a cost bridge showing how the remaining cost categories contribute to the requested increase?

Document doc:20260911-70110-P01 requests a 9.5% adjustment, which merits a transparent reconciliation with the cost drivers described.

Contract ctr:4600070110 remains valid through 31 December 2026, supporting a January implementation rather than November.

Could you consider €130.00 from 1 January 2027 with payment at 14 days to support your cash flow? Please identify any lower-cost production options that preserve the agreed specification.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200: cost basis and revised proposal
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We acknowledge your reference to the current contract and agree to adjust the effective date to 1 January 2027, alongside your proposed 14-day payment terms. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. 

Our technical colleagues will gladly discuss production options, though preserving your exact specifications remains our priority. It is always a pleasure working with our respected partners.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN casings: sustainable price agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for recognising the January implementation date. We can retain payment within 14 days to support your cash flow, provided the price reflects that benefit.

Could you agree to €132.00 from 1 January 2027? Alternatively, we propose €133.00 from 1 April 2027, also with 14-day payment.

Could you provide a confidential cost bridge, including the operating margin at these prices, so we can assess a sustainable agreement rather than simply shift cost pressure? Please also identify any process efficiencies achievable without changing the specification.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN casings: sustainable price agreement
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued partnership and the 14-day payment terms, which allow us to adjust our price to €134.20 per unit, valid from 1 January 2027, with a Zahlungsziel 14 days net. 

As a family-owned foundry, our cost structures and margins remain strictly confidential and we cannot provide the requested cost bridge. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.

Furthermore, our technical team confirms that our current processes are fully optimized for your exact specifications, leaving no room for further efficiencies without altering the design. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We value our long relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and look forward to continuing our work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN casings — implementation-date compromise
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for the revised offer. We respect your decision to keep internal margins confidential.

Could we retain your €134.20 unit price and 14-day payment terms, but implement the adjustment on 1 April 2027? This preserves your proposed ongoing price while giving us a transition period.

Alternatively, could you agree to €133.00 from 1 January 2027 with the same prompt payment? Please indicate which package better supports a sustainable agreement for your foundry.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN casings — implementation-date compromise
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our foundry values the long relationship we have built with your company over the years. We appreciate your understanding regarding our internal figures. However, delaying the implementation to April 2027 is not feasible for us, so we must build on your January proposal. 

We can offer a compromise of €133.60 per unit from 1 January 2027, maintaining the 14-day payment terms. For your reference, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

To summarize our current offer clearly, we are proposing a price of €133.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal serves as a fair path forward for both of our companies.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. It is always a pleasure to serve Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to continue the long relationship between our companies. We take great pride in our foundry's craftsmanship and look forward to delivering the quality you expect from us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
